purpose: OZM skill-library technical-debt ledger for SkillOps-style maintenance.

entries.evidence: Default packaged graph must match OZM-only package mode and use portable paths.
Activation must produce downstream artifact, blocker, proof posture, or claim effect.
Core skill surfaces were reduced below the active progressive-disclosure warning thresholds by exact-section extraction into references; T0 stops and activation gates remain in SKILL.md.

Outcome evals now include fixture-backed script executions for claim/evidence, reference gaps, method anchors, session hydration, text preflight, and route shadowing in addition to benchmark contracts.
Manifest script keys are package-root relative, all active scripts are declared, hashes are checked, and per-script read/write/network/external command metadata exists.
Eval all-suite writes full JSON to eval-last-run.json and stdout summary; ozm_build_package.py generates PACKAGE-LEDGER from real command outputs.
Active OZM skills now carry owner-specific artifacts, blockers, downstream fields, proof/script posture, and claim effects instead of only generic matrix/ledger wording.

Audit observed Linux/Python full process-group eval projected above suite timeout and benchmark no-spawn fixture failed when startup probe consumed suite budget. Fixed by excluding startup probe from suite timeout, adding safe in-process grouping, and adding platform matrix/live fixtures.

Audit proved plain Python imports can create __pycache__ under package tree. Fixed with ozm_py.py, ozm_clean_package --check-only --forbid-bytecode, and a dirty-tree regression fixture that demonstrates detect-and-clean behavior.

Audit found release_scorecard could pass from packaged artifacts while direct live fixtures failed. Fixed by adding release_scorecard --mode evidence/live/strict, critical fixture allowlist, runtime mismatch warnings, and strict scenario bundle evidence.
